subject: Interview plan: roles, scoring cadence, and debrief flow for Sr. Inference Engineer
messages:
From: Sasha Park <sasha@fastsearch.com>
To: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Markus Klein <markus_klein@redwood.com>, Grace O'Connor <grace_oconnor@redwood.com>
Date: Sun, 18 Apr 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Intro + proposed interview flow for Kyle Hanley (Sr. Inference Eng)

Hi team —

Thanks for taking a look at Kyle's profile (attached). He comes out of a small ML infra org and has explicit experience with inference runtimes + kernel tuning. Recruiter note: he prefers an in-depth technical panel (practical problem + system design + a 1:1 on model quality).

Quick ask: can we align on a compact interview flow (3 total interviews, 60m each) and a debrief cadence that keeps the loop under 48 hours? My proposed slots:
• Fri 4/23 10:00 — systems & runtime (Markus)
• Fri 4/23 11:30 — model quality & eval (Grace)
• Mon 4/26 14:00 — candidate fit + org questions (Laura)

Attachments: candidate-resume-KyleHanley.pdf

If this looks good I can lock times and send calendar invites.

—Sasha
Recruiter, FastSearch

From: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
To: Sasha Park <sasha@fastsearch.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Markus Klein <markus_klein@redwood.com>, Grace O'Connor <grace_oconnor@redwood.com>
Date: Sun, 18 Apr 2027 10:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Intro + proposed interview flow for Kyle Hanley (Sr. Inference Eng)

Thanks Sasha — good resume. I'll take the org/candidate-fit conversation; please keep it conversational and leave room for questions about shipping tradeoffs. A couple of notes for the panel: 

• Interview goals (per session):
  - Systems & runtime (Markus): focus on concrete past work (profiling, kernel tradeoffs, latency regressions). Look for depth in debugging and instrumentation.
  - Model quality & eval (Grace): evaluate thinking around eval design, dataset drift detection, and prompt-eval hygiene.
  - Candidate-fit (me): leadership, cross-team ops, and ambiguity handling.

• Scoring: use the attached interview-eval-template.xlsx — please mark both signal & risk items and provide a 1–2 sentence hire rationale.

• Debrief: 24–36 hour preferred. If we disagree, we escalate to a short async voting + 15m follow-up with the hiring manager.

Go ahead and book the calendar; Markus/Marissa/Grace — flag any conflicts.

Thanks,
Laura Bennett
Hiring Manager — Serving Runtime
Redwood Inference

From: Markus Klein <markus_klein@redwood.com>
To: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Grace O'Connor <grace_oconnor@redwood.com>
Cc: Sasha Park <sasha@fastsearch.com>
Date: Sun, 18 Apr 2027 12:17:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Intro + proposed interview flow for Kyle Hanley (Sr. Inference Eng)

Laura / team —

I can take the systems slot on Fri 4/23 at 10:00. Two small asks:
1) Can someone attach the sample problem I'd like to use (a small profiling/debugging exercise)? I prefer candidates to run through a real micro-benchmark and explain instrumentation choices.
2) I'll add a short rubric cell for "observability & triage" since that's a key SLO area for us.

I'll prepare the .ics and a short examiner note and upload to the shared doc. Attaching interviewer-rotations.ics and interview-eval-template.xlsx for visibility.

-Markus
Senior Staff, Serving Runtime

From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
To: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>, Markus Klein <markus_klein@redwood.com>, Grace O'Connor <grace_oconnor@redwood.com>
Date: Sun, 18 Apr 2027 14:40:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Intro + proposed interview flow for Kyle Hanley (Sr. Inference Eng)

Quick note — I'll be available to cover overlap if Markus needs a swap (out Thu morning). I'm happy to act as the independent reviewer (bar-raiser style) for the two technical sessions; I'll focus my write-ups on cross-cutting risks and impact.

Also adding a suggested debrief checklist:
• Consensus on hire/no-hire (Y/N/Borderline)
• Top 3 signals that moved you toward decision (concrete examples)
• Top 3 risks and mitigation plan if we hire
• Compensation anchor (LA/level rec) — brief note from hiring manager

If we do the 24–36 hour window, I propose we lock a 30m debrief block Mon 4/26 16:30 in case asynchronous voting splits.

—Marissa
Director, Talent Enablement (interview calibration lead)

From: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Markus Klein <markus_klein@redwood.com>, Grace O'Connor <grace_oconnor@redwood.com>, Sasha Park <sasha@fastsearch.com>
Date: Mon, 19 Apr 2027 16:45:00 -07:00
Subject: Finalized: interview schedule + debrief flow for Kyle Hanley (Sr. Inference Eng)

Thanks everyone — summary and next steps below. Please treat as the canonical plan for this loop.

Summary:
• Interviews (confirmed):
  - Fri 4/23 10:00 — Markus (systems & runtime) — 60m
  - Fri 4/23 11:30 — Grace (model quality & eval) — 60m
  - Mon 4/26 14:00 — Laura (candidate fit/org) — 60m
• Materials attached: candidate-resume-KyleHanley.pdf, interview-eval-template.xlsx, interviewer-rotations.ics
• Debrief cadence: start async votes within 6h of the final interview, provide completed evals within 24h. If votes are split or someone marks "Borderline" we meet Mon 4/26 16:30 for a 30m sync (calendar invite sent).
• Scoring expectations: fill the template, highlight 2 signal items and 1 immediate risk. Keep write-ups concise (3–5 bullets).

Action items:
• Sasha: lock candidate times and share dial-in (done).
• Markus: upload the small profiling exercise and examiner notes by Wed 4/21 EOD.
• Marissa: I'll rely on you for tie-break and compensation anchoring if we move forward.
• Grace: please prepare a short eval checklist for dataset drift that I can reference in the debrief.

Thanks — excited to meet Kyle.

Laura Bennett
Hiring Manager — Serving Runtime
Redwood Inference

Attachment stubs: candidate-resume-KyleHanley.pdf (pdf), interview-eval-template.xlsx (xlsx), interviewer-rotations.ics (calendar)
